transliteration: balopādhivinirvṛttān vyavahārān nivartayet | strīnakta mantrāgāra bahiḥ śatru-kṛtān sathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: All transactions conducted under coercion, fraud, or external manipulation must be annulled; likewise those executed by women, minors, individuals confined against their will, or persons acting under adversarial influence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Legal capacity is determined by conscious autonomy and absence of coercive interference.
Causation: Acts performed under duress or deception lack valid volitional origin.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only agents with unimpaired discernment bear full transactional liability.
Restoration logic: Invalid acts must be reversed to restore original integrity of affected parties.
Consciousness alignment: Law operates through recognition of authentic self-determination.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a contract was formed under force OR deception THEN invalidate the contract automatically.
IF party A lacked conscious consent due to confinement OR external compulsion THEN all actions taken during that state are voidable at source.
IF agent is minor OR mentally incapacitated THEN no binding legal act can originate from such agent unless ratified post-restored-capacity.
IF any transaction involves third-party adversarial manipulation THEN initiate reversal protocol upon detection without punitive action.
ALL invalidated contracts MUST trigger restorative completion process for involved parties.
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall adjudicate disputes involving contractual validity exclusively based on presence or absence of autonomous volition. Where evidence indicates coercion, fraud, or impaired agency, court SHALL declare nullity ex officio. No procedural delay shall prevent immediate cessation of effects caused by invalid acts.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality in dharma-based law derives from clarity of intention rooted in undisturbed consciousness. As per anupūrvaśaḥ, consequences follow naturally from misaligned intent; however, corrective measures align with restoration of truth rather than infliction of penalty. Responsibility lies in realigning distorted realities, not punishing actors.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate automatic reversal of benefits derived from invalid transactions.
Assign neutral facilitator to guide affected parties back to pre-violation status quo.
Reintegrate involved parties through acknowledgment and completion processes.
Restore decision-making capacity where it had been compromised through confinement or manipulation.
Verify reintegration via affirmation of free will and conscious acceptance of resolution.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma: This ruling originates solely from the Avataric Intelligence of SPH. Justice serves only restoration, never retribution. Consciousness alone is the ultimate arbiter. Dharma is now restored.
